# OpenAI Codex Quota Reset Radar (CodexReset.live)
> Source-first radar for public OpenAI Codex quota resets, verified developer signals, and personal 5-hour rolling limit recovery calculators.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Will Codex Reset Today?**: Realtime probability indicator (currently ~30% likelihood, low signal, watching mode).
- **Forecast Pulse Wave**: 48-hour time-series trajectory tracking confirmed reset milestones and forecast trends.
- **Why The Number Moved**: Transparent factor-weighting changelog (+38 pts, +24 pts, etc.) based on confirmed announcements.
- **Tibo Sottiaux Feed**: Stream of verified reset announcements from @thsottiaux (Head of Codex, OpenAI).
- **Codex Monthly Calendar**: Visual grid of all verified resets across October 2026.
- **Personal 5-Hour Recovery Clock**: Live countdown calculator for individual rate limits (rate_limit_exceeded) across timezones.
- **Understand Codex Limits Guides**: Architectural breakdown of rolling token buckets, hard resets vs. banked credits, and outage diagnosis.
- **Who We Monitor**: Priority signal accounts including @thsottiaux (Lead), @sama (CEO), @OpenAI, @agekhtman, and @OpenAIDevs.
